_comment: Facts the owner must supply or confirm before the redesign goes live. Set confirmed to true once done. `yarn build` lists what is still open; LAUNCH_STRICT=1 yarn build fails while anything is open.

facts.what: Legal mentions (LCEN): publisher identity, the host (IONOS, the VPS of g3wis/infra: name, address, phone), a contact. Add them to src/content/about.ts (privacy section).
The date of 'Étape 1' (STAGE_ORIGIN in src/game/stage.ts, today 20261116 as an assumption). It must never change once published.
May https://github.com/g3wis/ucicle/issues be shown to players as the place to report a data error?
Commit (or not) to 'sans publicité / no advertising' on the About page; it is left out until confirmed.
The live riders.json looks about 2023 (ages, teams such as Jumbo-Visma). Run the DataRide loader (functions LOAD_RIDERS) so the About page's data description and the board match reality.

After the first deploy of the ucicle stack (deploy/README.md): curl -sI --compressed https://www.ucicle.fr/ shows content-encoding: gzip (Traefik compress), http://ucicle.fr/ ends on https://www.ucicle.fr/, the home answers 200, and /sitemap-index.xml lists the rider sitemaps.
Reuse of UCI DataRide results for the index: no licence or terms were found. Get the UCI's written answer before launch (PRODUCT.md, 'Pending for launch').

The ucicle stack of g3wis/infra (deploy/README.md): its env.vault encrypted by the owner, the INFRA_DEPLOY_TOKEN secret here, the first full collect backfill and rate, then the DNS of ucicle.fr and www.ucicle.fr moved to the VPS.
Rider identities duplicated in the UCI's own records (rider_review: possible_duplicate, registry_duplicate): review them before launch; there is no merge tool yet (functions/SCHEMA.md).
Per-rider share images would need two new dependencies (satori, @resvg/resvg-js). Index pages use public/og/index.png until the owner decides.
Art direction question left open: keep one Tyvek strip per rider (validated contract), or print each start list as one sheet with a head band (cold-eyes proposal, rejected for v1). Owner's call.
